originalTitle: Lohia Corp IPO opens on July 23: Here’s all you need to know
simplifiedContent: Lohia Corp, a company that makes machinery for technical textiles, is going to start selling its shares to the public on July 23. This is called an Initial Public Offering (IPO). The company is selling over 2.59 crore of its existing shares, and it's a good time for them to do so because they've been doing well financially. In fact, they made 64% more profit in the last financial year compared to the previous one, and their revenue also increased by 25%. This IPO might be interesting to investors because of the company's strong financial performance.

originalTitle: JK Cement Q1 profit drops 15.3% YoY to Rs 274.62 crore
simplifiedContent: JK Cement, a company, made a profit of Rs 274.62 crore in the first quarter of this year, which is 15.3% less than what they made last year. Last year, they made a profit of Rs 324.25 crore. Despite the decrease in profit, the company's sales (or revenue) actually went up by 20.25% to Rs 4,031.72 crore. However, their expenses also increased by 25.5%, which means they spent more money this year than last year. This matters because it shows how the company's financial performance has changed from last year to this year.

originalTitle: RBL Bank Q1 Results: Net profit rises 27% YoY to Rs 254 crore; Emirates NBD ownership boosts growth outlook
simplifiedContent: RBL Bank just released its quarterly results, and its profit increased by 27% compared to the same time last year, reaching Rs 254 crore. The bank also saw a 12% increase in the income it earns from interest on loans. This is good news for the bank, and it's partly because Emirates NBD now owns a majority of the bank, which is expected to bring in more business opportunities. The bank's management thinks this will lead to more growth in areas like corporate banking and trade finance. This increase in profit and potential for future growth could be a positive sign for investors.

originalTitle: IPO GMP Check: SBI Funds Management IPO vs Alpine Texworld IPO - What grey market signals ahead of listings?
simplifiedContent: Two companies, SBI Funds Management and Alpine Texworld, recently finished their initial public offering (IPO) process, which allows them to raise money by selling shares to the public. SBI Funds Management had a lot of interest, with its shares being oversubscribed 41.66 times, and is expected to start trading at a premium of ₹91. In contrast, Alpine Texworld had much less interest, with its shares being oversubscribed only 1.40 times, and is expected to start trading at a premium of just ₹1. This suggests that investors are more excited about SBI Funds Management's stock, which could affect how the two companies perform when their shares start trading. The difference in interest may indicate how well each company's stock will do when it lists on the market.

originalTitle: ICICI Bank Q1 Results 2026: Net profit rises 16% to  ₹14,804.50 crore
simplifiedContent: ICICI Bank recently released its financial results for the first quarter of 2026. The bank's net profit, which is the amount of money it made after expenses, was ₹14,804.50 crore. This is a 16% increase from the same time last year, when the bank made ₹12,768.21 crore. This news matters because it shows that the bank is performing well and making more money than it did last year. The increase in net profit is a positive sign for the bank and its investors, indicating that the bank's business is growing.

originalTitle: Yes Bank Q1 results 2026: Net profit jumps 33.7% YoY, operating profit up 25.5%
simplifiedContent: Yes Bank just released its financial results for the first quarter of 2026, and its net profit (or total earnings) increased by 33.7% compared to the same time last year. This means the bank made more money this year than it did last year. The bank's operating profit also went up by 25.5%, which is a good sign for the company's overall health. The net profit for this quarter was ₹1,071 crore, which is a bit higher than the previous quarter. This increase in profit is a positive sign for Yes Bank and its investors.
